messages.en: What are you doing?
I'm off work now.
I'm already going to Japan tomorrow.
I'll wake up in Japan.
I've lost count of how many days I've gone without sleeping overnight,
but somehow, I'm so wired
that I'm in full Energizer Bunny mode.
I've done lots of things Y/n will like,
so look forward to them!
I'm not tired at all. I'm okay.
I'm excited to go to Japan for the first time in a while.
Hayeon's such a strong, healthy girl.
Seriously.
Even the members are surprised.
They say, Hayeon really never gets sick.
They say it's amazing ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
It's because you eat well.
I think that's actually true.
I keep making sure to eat between things,
so maybe that's why I'm healthy.
I can't function without the energy I get from food.
Lately, while filming Magical Girl,
I'm really becoming an all-rounder.
Just in a different way.
I'm discovering my knack for getting things done and all my vaguely useful talents.
I'm only a little good at everything,
so it's fun ㅋㅎㅋㅅㅋㄹㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 마법소녀 간거중에 뭐가 제일 적성에 맞았어
messages.en: Of the things you've done on Magical Girl, what suited you best?
Something that hasn't come out yet.

messages.ko: 근데 마법소녀 꽤 오래 했더라 하요이 대단해
messages.en: You've been doing Magical Girl for quite a while. Hayeon, you're amazing.
Probably.
I think we'll keep doing it all the way through next year.
As long as Y/n enjoys watching it, that's all that matters~
Joobin and Chaewon appeared on Magical Girl,
then left completely exhausted ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋ
This takes stamina
and the ability to endure the cringe.
Recording the crystal ball lines must feel so cringe ㅋㅋㅋ
No, Sujeong's voice is gradually
turning into Jeong Hayeon's voice.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Sujeong needs to get back to her roots.

messages.ko: 눈 감고 들으면 누가 수정이고 마법소녀인지 몰라요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: If I close my eyes and listen, I can't tell who's Sujeong and who's the Magical Girl ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
My older brother was reviewing my video,
and he saw Jeong Hayeon talking to Jeong Hayeon,
so he wondered what was going on.
ㅋㅅㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋ
My dad and my older brother are on the phone right now,
so I'll pass along exactly what they're saying.
Brother: Hello! Go, Wavve Jeong Hayeon!

messages.ko: 아빠:우리 하연이 아꺄줘서 고마워요 건강 조심하고 잘 지내세요~
messages.en: Dad: Thank you for cherishing our Hayeon. Take care of your health and stay well~
Brother: It's cold out. Have some chueotang.

messages.ko: 오빠: 내가 너무 재밌어서 정하연이 재미없어보이는거임
messages.en: Brother: I'm so funny that Jeong Hayeon looks boring by comparison.
That's what they're saying.
That chueotang joke is so outdated.

messages.ko: 안녕하세요 하연이 아버님, 오빠분.. 저 하연이 여자친구입니다 사실 말씀을 언제 드려야할지 많이 고민했는데 여기서 말씀드리네요 저희 만난지 4일밖에 되지 않았지만 열심히 사랑해서 결혼까지 하겠습니다 추울텐데 감기 조심하시고 곧 상견례로 찾아뵙겠습니다! ㅎㅎ
messages.en: Hello, Hayeon's father and older brother. I'm Hayeon's girlfriend. I've been wondering when I should tell you this, and I've decided to say it here. We've only been together for four days, but we'll love each other wholeheartedly and get married. It's cold, so please be careful not to catch a cold. We'll come see you soon for the formal family meeting! ㅎㅎ
When I told them about that,
they seriously started wondering who should arrange the family meeting.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ
I'm losing it.
Those two are so noisy.
I can't concentrate on chatting with you ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
They're having a joke battle.

messages.ko: 뭔가 결혼이 아니더라도 너네 가족되고 싶다
messages.en: Even if we don't get married, I kind of want to become part of your family.
Wanna join?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ When I passed that along,
they said, You'll probably get really stressed~~
That's what those two said.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 오빠: 살면서 나처럼 착한사람을 본 적이 없어
messages.en: Brother: You've never met anyone as kind as me in your life.
I don't know why he wanted me to pass that along.
Tell Hayeon I love her...
She says she loves you too~
What does your family call you?
My older brother calls me 'Piggy~',
my dad calls me 'Daughter~',
and my mom calls me 'Our celebrity~'.
And my older brother is always sending me baby pig shorts
all the time.
Why are you here?
He says that,
and after sending so many, eventually
he just sends 'ㅇ ㅇㄱㅇㄴ?'
That's all he sends now.
It's the initials for 'Why are you here?'
But baby pigs are really cute. Baby pigs are my favorite animals.
I'm okay with baby pigs too.
They're cute.
But fully grown pigs are a little...
They might need to appear on Odyssey.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
I've finished packing.
My bed is so wonderful.
It's been so long, Elizabeth XIX ㅠㅠ
That's the name of my bed.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 내가 요즘 너무 신경을 못써줬지 ㅠㅠ
messages.en: I haven't been able to give you much attention lately, have I? ㅠㅠ
I'm home now~~
I'll give you a kiss before I go to sleep.

messages.ko: 근데 이제 다시 일본 가야해서 작별인사 해야해..
messages.en: But now you have to say goodbye because you're going back to Japan..
Just hang in there for a week... Don't cry ㅠㅠㅠ
You're jealous?
You're even jealous of my bed...
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ

messages.ko: 근데 며칠 못 잤으면 침대에 눕자마자 잠드는 거 아님..?
messages.en: But if you haven't slept for days, wouldn't you fall asleep the moment you lie down?
Yep, that's right!
I have to leave soon,
so I'll try to sleep, Y/n.
Should I try filming a vlog in Japan too?
I'll think about it if my face looks pretty tomorrow.
My editing skills will improve too, then.
ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋ
Goodnight~
Haranghae ❤️❤️🐷
